generalCriterionList.description: The bidders fulfilling all rules/conditions said in the tender document are eligible. Latest Circulars from Govt. are also applicable.

As per tender Agreement clause 24.1, the successful tenderer shall submit the Security Deposit(Performance Security) infavour of Executive Engineer in the form of Bankers Cheque/Pay order for an amount of equivalent to 5% of the contract price and also an additional security for unbalanced tender amount in the form of FDR of any Nationalised Bank within 7 days of receipt of the letter of acceptance and shall enter into an agreement and the work shall be started within a week after agreement. The Name in the FDR/STAMP Paper as per Contractor License.

All the documents pertaining to technical bid should be attested by the gazetted officer not less than the grade of District Level Officer. If not said bid shall be rejected and he should be able to produce the attested document at any time, if required.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The contractor is supposed to purchase all required materials on his own for carrying out the work, and all the materials shall be tested for its quality prior to construction and its quality shall be of ISI standards.
An amount of 1% shall be deducted towards Labour Less from each of the running bill of the contractor.
Tenders from joint ventures are not acceptable.
Conditional tenders are subjected for rejection.
Acceptance/Cancellation of the works are reserved by undersigned without any reasons for the same.

All bidders shall upload the details of the following documents: i) Contractor Registration. ii) Works completed in last 5 years. iii) Details of minimum quantities of work done in one year. iv) Yearly turnover from last 5 years. v) Present ongoing works. vi) Tener bid Capacity should be more than Tender amount

As per Director, Department of Mines and Geology Bengaluru Circular For the year 2023-24 dated: 07-11-2023, if the contractors fail to submit the Mineral Dispatch Permit(MDP) along with the bill for the sub-minerals used for the works, action will be taken as per the said circular.

itemList.description: Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates: Wall

Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work. Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method): Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density. Ch. From 0.00 km To  0.274km

Providing and constructing un-reinforced plain cement concrete pavement, thickness as per design, over a prepared sub base, with 43 grade cement or any other type as per Clause 1501.2.2 M20 (Grade), coarse and fine aggregates conforming to IS:383:2016:, maximum size of coarse aggregate not exceeding 25 mm, mixed in a concrete mixer of not less than 0.2 cum capacity and appropriate weigh batcher using approved mix design, laid in approved fixed side formwork (steel channel, laying and fixing of 125 micron thick polythene film, wedges, steel plates including levelling the formwork as per drawing), spreading the concrete with shovels, rakes, compacted using needle, screed and plate vibrators and finished in continuous operation including construction joints, primer, sealant, curing of concrete slabs for 14-days, and water finishing to lines and grade as per drawing and technical specification clause 1501 with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.
